lineas.texto: India pumps more groundwater than the US and China combined.
In Punjab, farmers grow rice, and rice drinks a lot of water.
Not long ago, a simple hand pump reached water a few meters down.
But pump faster than the rain refills it, and the water table drops.
A pump on top can only pull water up about eight meters. Then it sucks air.
So farmers lower electric pumps deeper, and deeper, every few years.
In some districts, the water drops close to a meter a year.
The fix: less thirsty crops, and ways to let the rain soak back in.
